title: Timeline: frame labelType not passed to FrameCell (no flag/anchor icon)
description: FrameCell in Timeline.tsx (line 199) only receives the label string, not labelType. Flash 8 renders: 'name' labels as a red flag triangle, 'anchor' labels as an anchor icon, 'comment' labels as a green zigzag. Fix: (1) pass labelType prop to FrameCell, (2) render a distinct visual indicator based on type — red small triangle flag for 'name', different color/style for 'anchor' and 'comment'. Currently all render the same regardless of type.
